notes: 1914 white stucco house at the Francisco corner, E side of Hyde. Three storeys under a steep dark pitched roof (roof block with a hipped cap above a 9.8 m eave line), thin vertical battens on the upper storeys over a string course, one shallow squared bay at the Francisco end of the upper storeys, dark near-black window frames; ground: a wide arched-look window left of centre and two small casement pairs at the right end, no garage on Hyde. Francisco face (edge 0) is a windowed flank. Front gable, attic arched window and chimney have no key. Ground windows sat on the pavement like shopfronts; sills raised (bulkhead 1.1 m). Steep dark-brown hipped roof with a taller front hip-gable over the left/centre (roof blocks under a 8.9 m eave; no gable key), small ridge chimney, dark fascia; the cant bay removed (the Francisco end is only a shallow squared overhang the kit cannot draw); bright white wall, thin battens with a mid-height half-timber rail, heavier belt band; upper windows only a dark casement pair at the right end; ground: arched multi-light window left of centre and two casements at the right with stucco sills over the frame legs. Steeper street-facing front roof over the left/centre (narrower 5.0 m block, 3.3 m rise, ~49 deg, darker roof) - still a hipped front end, the kit has no vertical gable key; upper storeys 2.75 m under an 8.6 m eave so the roof shows taller; ground arched window reworked as one squat segmental-arched multi-light window (arch springs 0.35 m down into the window, dark glass, higher stucco sill, ~1.7:1); battens widened to 0.14 m with a heavier floor belt; wall #f4f3ee. Arch ring drawn in the dark frame colour (reads as the dark arched frame, not a pale fan), flatter segment. Battens tightened to ~0.8 m spacing; ground casements squared (0.9 m wide, sill 1.0, head 1.9); eave block now dark shingle with a thin white frieze; arch flatter. Mirror claim skipped again. Mirror claim skipped. Battens widened to ~2.2 m (7 panels) CONFIRMED; corner pilaster/console brackets at the Hyde end CONFIRMED; panel under arch made wall-coloured; chimney to 0.62; true vertical gable has no key (hipped front kept). Rework: ground feature window rebuilt as a segmental-arched multi-pane window (layout arch) with sill 1.1 m; battens narrowed to 0.10 m; eaves trimmed to 0.3 m; wall lifted to f8f7f2. Battens confirmed vertical-dominant, narrowed to 0.08 m at ~1.4 m spacing, mid rail thinned; white wall, dark roof, corner pilaster kept. True front gable + apex window have no key (hipped front kept; previous rounds). Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
